title: Sign of Wilson-Fermion Determinant using Contour-Integral Spectral Projection
summary: Key properties of a large sparse operator can often be determined by only a small, spectrally localized subset of its eigenmodes. In lattice QCD with Wilson fermions, the sign of the fermion determinant is determined by the parity of the number of eigenvalues lying on the negative real axis of the non-Hermitian Wilson-Dirac operator. Determination of this signature can be challenging, particularly in parameter regimes where near-zero modes can lead to exceptional configurations.
